    "2026-08-11T09:15:00Z ERROR disk full\n"
    "2026-08-11T14:23:05Z INFO started\n"
    "not a log line at all\n"
    "2026-08-11T14:41:00Z ERROR timeout\n"
    "2026-08-11T14:52:00Z ERROR timeout again\n"

)
